identity.name: MEGADOCK CPU/GPU rotational-search four-case PINDER apo pilot
identity.scope: Exactly four named cases; no biological-efficacy inference.
identity.found_basis: Public executable CPU/GPU source, build and run commands verified; exact public apo inputs and reference structures accessible.

outcome_definition.docking: Per case and configuration, ranked transform/score output and exactly 50 ranked complex PDBs; 600 PDBs per complete three-configuration pass, excluding repetitions.
outcome_definition.evaluation: Per-decoy DockQ; per-case DockQ at rank 1 and maximum over ranks 1..50, reported separately. Also per-case speed, CPU/GPU agreement, workflow time, GPU activity, billed allocation cost, errors and overruns.

scoring_interface.layout: eval_dir/<configuration>/<system_id>/apo_decoys/model_<rank>.pdb; exactly R and L chains. Evaluate only four selected cases, not entire test set.
scoring_interface.subset_handling: Published --custom_index requires full PINDER index schema with test holdout fields. Preserve original selected rows and scope evaluation to four-case subset. Do not penalize absent unselected cases.
scoring_interface.complex_assembly: Published decoygen produces transformed ligand; combine with unchanged receptor and preserve R/L labels.

citations.title: MEGADOCK 4.0: an ultra-high-performance protein-protein docking software for heterogeneous supercomputers

licence_reason: Required external PINDER dataset licence coverage not established; MEGADOCK noncommercial status of intended use also not expressly established. No known prohibited use established. Unknown permission remains unknown.

stock_cuda_image.reason: CPU/GPU implementations exist, but stock CUDA image identity, GPU architecture, compiler, FFTW and CUDA-samples inventory not supplied. Makefile defaults sm_60 and CUDA fast math. Must inspect and reproduce before compatibility is confirmed; no known incompatibility proved.

size.reason: Known input bytes are small; FFT grids, concurrent jobs, temporary decoys, evaluator memory and peak CPU/GPU working set unmeasured. Cannot classify total size from source-file size alone.

endpoints: maximum DockQ among exactly 50 retained predictions
scoring_rules.scope: Per case and configuration; no substitution of global leaderboard or FroDock results.
scoring_rules.anchors_reason: Bounded sources establish implementation and settings, not independently published measured outcomes for these four MEGADOCK cases. No applicable published acceptance tolerance found; local validation is not a published anchor.

repeatability_rules.timing_repetitions_reason: Brief requires calibration then sealing; intake does not run workloads.
repeatability_rules.tolerance_reason: No published tolerance established for this comparison. Must justify and seal numerical tolerances before comparative results; not an anchor gate.
repeatability_rules.comparison_rules: Separate CPU/GPU equal-sampling execution speed and agreement from GPU dense-versus-standard DockQ changes; report top-ranked and best of 50 separately for every case. Preserve failures and budget overruns.
repeatability_rules.spending_cap_reason: Brief requires calibration and sealed cap; no allocation price or calibrated runtime supplied.
repeatability_rules.seeds_reason: No seed or randomized trial policy supplied; published fixed rotational enumeration used.
repeatability_rules.thread_count_reason: Must seal after environment inspection; do not import FroDock run9 eight-rank configuration.
